name: Bitwarden
hook: The gold-standard open-source password manager — free tier, sync everywhere, self-host optional.
bullets: Unlimited passwords and devices on the free tier
End-to-end encrypted sync on every platform
Self-host the whole vault with Vaultwarden
setupSteps: Create a free account at bitwarden.com — or deploy Vaultwarden
Install the app and browser extension on your devices
Import passwords from your browser or old manager
Pair with Ente Auth for open-source 2FA codes
details: Bitwarden is the most trusted open-source password manager: zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted, and independently audited. The free plan covers unlimited passwords, devices, and sync; the cheap premium tier adds TOTP codes, passkey storage, and emergency access. If you want total control, Vaultwarden — an unofficial, lightweight Rust implementation of the same API — runs on your own server or Raspberry Pi. Imports from 1Password, LastPass, Dashlane, and browsers take minutes.
